title: RA-DPO: Reliability-Aware Preference Optimization and Selective Prediction for Sexism Detection
description: Reliability-aware preference optimization and selective prediction for sexism detection. Turns annotator disagreement into a reliability score R(x) = alpha * confidence + beta * agreement + gamma * (1 - token uncertainty) that weights DPO preference pairs during training and gates predict/abstain decisions at inference. Evaluated on EXIST 2023 (EN/ES) and EDOS with gpt-4o, Llama-3.2-3B, and Qwen2.5-3B backbones. Ships per-instance prediction arrays so the coverage-accuracy results reproduce without API access.
